acceptance_criteria: Profile ids are opaque random values; names, birth dates or other personal data never appear in ids or storage keys
Data written for one profile is never readable through another profile, and deleting a profile removes every key it owns while other profiles stay intact
Export produces a versioned document; restoring it into an empty store reproduces the profile and its data exactly
A malformed, truncated or incompatible-version import is rejected and leaves the store unchanged
A failed multi-key write does not leave a half-written profile visible
No runtime dependency is added; src/profiles uses no network API
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: Several child profiles on one device with isolated local data: a versioned ProfileV1, a profile store over a pluggable key-value backend, and a versioned export, restore and delete round trip
non_goals: User interface, board wiring, gesture examples, encryption, sync or any network use
Claims that the IndexedDB adapter is verified; it has no real-browser test until card NG-14
